hero.tagline: Serving with Faith • Unity • Justice • Humanity

about.title: A Journey of Faith and Dedication
about.leadText: "By the immense grace of Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala, and with the prayers of Ahlul Bayt Alayhimussalam, we are honored and grateful to announce that the Tamil Nadu Shia Muslim Jamaat has successfully completed its first year."
about.quote: Our dedication stems from the eternal teachings of the Holy Prophet (PBUH) and the Ahlulbayt (AS), striving for community welfare, educational upliftment, and mutual brotherhood.

quotes.bismillahTranslation: In the Name of Allah, The Most Gracious, The Most Merciful

imamAli.text: People are of two types: either your brother in faith, or your equal in humanity.

prophet.text: As long as a person helps his brother, Allah will continue to help him.

humanitarian.title: A commitment to humanity in times of need.
humanitarian.description: True faith is demonstrated through compassionate action. When tragedy struck the Meena School in Iran resulting in the tragic loss of 167 children, the Jamaat stepped forward to aid in the reconstruction efforts.
humanitarian.quote: "As long as a person helps his brother, Allah will continue to help him."

education.title: Educational Support & Encouragement
education.description: We believe that education is the foundation of a strong and just society. During our first year, we prioritized supporting students in their academic journeys.

cards.title: Students Supported
cards.desc: Provided essential school bags and notebooks to ensure students have the tools they need to succeed.

cards.title: Academic Achievers
cards.desc: Awarded special prizes and ₹2,000 incentives each to students passing 10th and 12th grades with high marks.

cards.title: Muharram Campaign
cards.desc: Digital banners displayed across central locations in Chennai commemorating the timeless sacrifice of Karbala and Imam Hussain (AS).

cards.title: Awareness Literature
cards.desc: 5,000 copies of the profound booklet "Karbala — A History of Sacrifice" were successfully distributed across more than 10 mosques.

cards.title: 10-Day Sabeel
cards.desc: Honoring the thirst of the martyrs, juice, buttermilk, and cold water were continuously distributed to the public on Peters Road during the first 10 days of Muharram.

quote.text: People are of two types: either your brother in faith, or your equal in humanity.

objectives.title: Unity
objectives.desc: To unite all Muslims without any division, fostering a resilient and inseparable brotherhood across all communities.

objectives.title: Religious Harmony
objectives.desc: To maintain and promote religious harmony in society, building bridges of understanding and mutual respect.

objectives.title: Respect for Law
objectives.desc: To respect and abide by the laws of the Central and State Governments, serving as exemplary and responsible citizens.

objectives.title: Propagation of Tawheed
objectives.desc: To spread the message of Monotheism among the people, illuminating hearts with the divine truth of the Almighty.

objectives.title: Glorifying Ahlul Bayt
objectives.desc: To propagate the virtues and greatness of the Prophet's family, ensuring their noble legacy guides future generations.

objectives.title: Wilayat of Ali
objectives.desc: To convey the Wilayat of Imam Ali (AS), illuminating the path of spiritual leadership and divine guidance.

objectives.title: Message of Karbala
objectives.desc: To implement the objectives and sacrifices of Karbala, standing firmly for justice and truth in every era.

objectives.title: Educational Assistance
objectives.desc: To provide educational support to poor and underprivileged students, empowering them to build a brighter future.

objectives.title: Social Service
objectives.desc: To support poor mothers and senior citizens, ensuring they receive the dignity, care, and compassion they deserve.

objectives.title: Medical Service
objectives.desc: To conduct free medical camps, bringing essential healthcare and relief to the most vulnerable members of society.

objectives.title: Cleanliness Drive
objectives.desc: To engage in cleanliness activities in schools, colleges, libraries, and hospitals, promoting a pure and healthy environment.

objectives.title: Legal Protection
objectives.desc: To provide clarification against those who spread defamation about Shias, and to address them legally if necessary to protect our community's honor.
